springBoot.checkTestConstructors.title: Warn when a Spring test class has a constructor with parameters that Spring will not autowire
springBoot.checkTestConstructors.description: Checks source constructor signatures against known test/autowire facts; unknown configuration stays quiet.

springBoot.checkEventListeners.title: Check the parameters and return type of @EventListener methods
springBoot.checkEventListeners.description: Source-local method signature checks; runtime event delivery is not evaluated.

springBoot.checkConfigurationProperties.title: Check @ConfigurationProperties prefixes and constructor binding
springBoot.checkConfigurationProperties.description: Checks source prefix/constructor annotations; does not prove effective relaxed-binding owners.

springBoot.checkEarlyEvents.title: Warn about @EventListener methods for events published before the context exists
springBoot.checkEarlyEvents.description: Checks known early event types in source; startup execution is not performed.

springBoot.checkApplicationSetup.title: Check @SpringBootApplication classes (default package, redundant annotations)
springBoot.checkApplicationSetup.description: Checks source application annotations and package facts; no run configuration is created.

springBoot.checkTestLifecycle.title: Check @DirtiesContext modes and @BeforeTransaction/@AfterTransaction signatures
springBoot.checkTestLifecycle.description: Checks source test lifecycle annotations/signatures; tests are not executed.
